title: Lifecycle Hooks: Component Birth to Death
description: Understand the component lifecycle and the hooks that let you tap into it.

slides.title: The Component Lifecycle
slides.content:
# From Creation to Destruction

Every Vue component goes through a series of stages from when it is created until it is destroyed. Vue provides **lifecycle hooks** – special methods that run at each stage, allowing you to execute your own code.

```
create → mount → update → unmount
```

Think of it as a **human lifecycle**: birth (created), childhood (mounted), adulthood (updates), and death (unmounted).

slides.title: Hook Diagram
slides.content:
## Lifecycle Diagram (Simplified)

```
    beforeCreate
         ↓
    created
         ↓
    beforeMount
         ↓
    mounted
         ↓
    beforeUpdate ← data changes
         ↓
    updated
         ↓
    beforeUnmount
         ↓
    unmounted
```

Each hook gives you a chance to do something at that moment.

quizData.question: What is the correct order of lifecycle hooks when a component is first created?
quizData.explanation: The correct order is beforeCreate → created → beforeMount → mounted. The component is then ready.
